useCases.title: Shop for the cheapest model without lock-in
useCases.summary: Compare list prices, switch with a string
useCases.problem: The cheapest SKU on a landing page is often the wrong unit (cached vs uncached, input vs output) or a model that is not actually serving.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/auto",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'
snippets.title: curl · anyrouter/auto

steps: Compare models on /models and /compare — use the published list prices, not screenshots.
Start traffic on anyrouter/auto so health-aware failover avoids a dead cheap SKU.
Pin a specific id only after you have measured quality on your prompts.
